title: Dimension of a vector-space quotient
statement: Let $k$ be a field and $V$ a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space, with dimension as in [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. For every $k$-linear subspace $U\subseteq V$, the spaces $U$ and $V/U$ are finite-dimensional and $\dim_k(V/U)+\dim_kU=\dim_kV$.
